Welcome to Widmer End Community Combined School
SEND
Special Educational Needs and Disability (SEND)
Widmer End Community Combined School is a nurturing and inclusive primary school that caters for the needs of all pupils, who can be taught in the mainstream setting. We make a commitment to ensure that each child develops to their full potential in all areas of the curriculum and in every aspect of school life.
For any enquiries regarding SEND please contact our SENDCo Mrs Louise Ross-Wood via send@widmerend.bucks.sch.uk or by calling the School office on 01494 714371.
SEND Information Report
Local Offer for SEND in Buckinghamshire The Local Offer gives children and young people with SEND, and their families, information about what support services the local authority think will be available in their local area. pageCache.text:
Welcome to Widmer End Community Combined School
Curriculum
All aspects of our curriculum are accessible to all children, irrespective of their ethnic background, gender, disability, religious or linguistic background. We strive hard to meet the needs of those pupils with special educational needs, those with disabilities, those who are more able and with special gifts and talents, and the children who are learning English as an additional language. We provide a rich, challenging curriculum, which stretches all of our children. Staff are aware of children who have exceptional talents and gifts and monitor their progress carefully to ensure their academic potential or talent is continually developed. For further details, please see separate policies.

Welcome to Widmer End Community Combined School
Holiday Clubs
Holiday Clubs
Add+VENTURE Wrap around care and holiday club is owned by Kat Gayler and Jemme Atieno. Kat and Jemme both have over 20 years' experience of working with early years children and have both managed and led early years settings. They launched Add+VENTURE Club in 2018 and became Ofsted registered in 2019, which allowed them to take children as young as 2 years. Add+VENTURE Club are in the process of this application for Widmer End. Their passion is to help working families like themselves, by providing an excellent childcare service, where children are well looked after in a safe, stimulating environment. Children at club learn their values: -
STAY SAFE......BE ACTIVE.....MAKE FRIENDS....

Welcome to Widmer End Community Combined School
School Clubs
School Clubs
We are fortunate to be able to offer a variety of clubs throughout the year due to the dedication of Staff, Parent helpers and local coaches. As well as after school clubs we also offer peripatetic music lessons in Rock music, Guitar, Drums, Ukulele, Singing and Piano. We try to vary the age range that the club is aimed at so all children have a chance to attend clubs throughout the year. Children are able to sign up for 8-12 weeks of a particular club before the start of each term. They are encouraged to sustain their engagement with the club and commit to the learning provided.

Wraparound Childcare
Wraparound Childcare
We have a fantastic wraparound care provider, Friends at Play. This exciting partnership offers families a really flexible choice of timings and a healthy offering of food and snacks. Friends at Play are a well established wraparound care provider who currently serve other local schools in the area and their testimonials are excellent.
They offer wraparound care to the pre-school children, accepting 30 hour funding, childcare vouchers and tax free childcare.
